Elevate your everyday wardrobe with our Classic Crewneck Cotton T-Shirt in Crisp White. Crafted from 100% premium combed cotton, this essential tee offers an exceptionally soft feel, breathable comfort, and a structured fit that retains its shape wear after wear.

Designed for effortless versatility, it features a clean front profile and a tailored side profile for a polished look whether worn solo or layered under a jacket.

Key Features:

Material: 100% Super Soft Combed Cotton

Fit: Regular / Classic Fit

Neckline: Durable Ribbed Crew Neck

Care: Machine wash cold, tumble dry low
